CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to content present; command labels alone do not qualify.

COD.rationale: Content identifier (red set) and separate organization/origin fields for the same referent/time are both present explicitly.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing-condition claim linked to the same content's presentation/access; command labels and candidate tags alone do not qualify.

C.rationale: Explicit named content entries (color-labeled sets with coordinates) identify content and attribute.

D.rationale: Content identification (red set) is separately accompanied by an explicit organization/status field (origin) for the same referent/time.

O.rationale: Explicit origin/representation fields and layout statement describe how content is organized/presented/accessed.
